quote.text: We shall be rich with all the more comfort, if we once learn how far poverty is from being a burden
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the idea that true richness lies in inner virtues; teach your children that love, integrity, and compassion are treasures that no external hardship can deplete.
    • Encourage resilience by showing that even modest means can be the soil for cultivating a life rich in character, inspiring gratitude and resourcefulness in overcoming challenges.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that effective leadership is not measured by material accumulation but by the strength of one’s principles, moral clarity, and the ability to inspire others despite scarcity.
    • Use constraints as a crucible to refine your strategies; understand that encountering and managing limitations can forge a leader who is wise, innovative, and empathetic.
  • Product Management
    • See every limitation as an opportunity for innovation; constraints in resources can spark creative solutions that deliver real value and efficiency to users.
    • Adopt a mindset that measures a product’s success by its ability to serve genuine needs, nurturing a culture where quality, purpose, and user satisfaction outweigh mere features or profit.
